panels.title: 1) Open orders by delivery date and status

targets.rawSql: SELECT delivery_date AS "Delivery Date", status AS "Status", open_orders AS "Open Orders" FROM analytics.vw_open_orders_by_delivery_date_status;

panels.title: 2) Top 3 delivery dates with more open orders

targets.rawSql: SELECT delivery_date AS "Delivery Date", open_orders AS "Open Orders" FROM analytics.vw_top3_delivery_dates_open_orders;
SELECT product_id AS "Product ID", product_name AS "Product", pending_items AS "Pending Items" FROM analytics.vw_pending_items_by_product;

panels.title: 4) Top 3 customers with more pending orders

targets.rawSql: SELECT customer_id AS "Customer ID", customer_name AS "Customer", pending_orders AS "Pending Orders" FROM analytics.vw_top3_customers_pending_orders;
